_note: Tags are one MODIS Terra morning pass per day, judged by eye at the Jeddah pin (21.49 N, 39.18 E). They describe cloud at the Terra overpass, not the whole day. Haze over land looks like dust and was not counted as cloud. 'no-image' = Terra swath missed Jeddah (black no-data area); engine must treat it as NOT usable for optical (conservative, unknown) and the UI must say 'no image'.
